description:
7AI is seeking a high-velocity, revenue-driven Sr. Director, EMEA Alliances to define, build, and scale our partner ecosystem across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. 7AI runs a 100% partner-led go-to-market, and EMEA is a greenfield region: you will stand up the alliance organization from the ground up, recruit and enable the partners who will carry 7AI to market, and build a predictable, ecosystem-led growth engine that operates at scale ahead of and alongside the in-region sales team.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned leader who has launched or scaled a partner-led business in EMEA and excels at turning regional partner networks into an exponential revenue multiplier. You will be responsible for setting the EMEA alliance vision, recruiting and activating focus partners across the UK, DACH, France, the Nordics, Benelux, Southern Europe, and the Middle East, accelerating co-sell revenue, and embedding 7AI into the core go-to-market strategies of resellers, distributors, managed SOC/MDR providers, and global systems integrators. You will also build and mentor the EMEA alliance function as it grows. If you are a strategic leader who views partnerships through the lens of pipeline generation, ARR impact, and long-term market dominance, this role is for you.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Own the EMEA Ecosystem Revenue Strategy: Set, drive, track, and exceed EMEA partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and ARR targets, owning the full P&L impact of the alliance motion across the region.

  • Define the EMEA Alliance Vision: Develop and execute a comprehensive, country-by-country partner strategy, including segmentation, tiering, and investment prioritization across Resellers, Distributors, Managed SOC/MDR providers, Global and Regional SIs, Tech Alliances, and Cloud Partners.

  • Recruit and Launch Focus Partners: Identify, sign, and onboard a focused set of Tier 1 and Tier 2 partners in each priority market, including the UK practices of global SIs, in-country resellers, and managed SOC/MDR providers who will build 7AI into their service offerings.

  • Accelerate Co-Sell Orchestration: Architect and lead high-velocity co-sell motions between 7AI sellers and key EMEA partners to unlock net-new logos and compress sales cycles, including routing and governance of partner-sourced opportunities during the build-out of the in-region sales team.

  • Scale Partner Activation: Transform partnerships from transactional agreements into scalable, repeatable revenue channels through structured account-mapping, joint business planning, partner certification, and executive-level pipeline reviews.

  • Build & Lead the Function: Establish the operating framework, processes, and people that power EMEA alliances, hiring and developing in-region alliance managers as the business grows and serving as the senior leader accountable for results.

  • Cross-Functional Revenue Alignment: Partner closely with 7AI's Executive, Marketing, Product, Solutions Architecture, and Sales leadership to build compelling, repeatable joint value propositions and localized enablement that incentivize partners to lead with 7AI.

  • Executive Relationship Ownership: Cultivate and own C-level and senior executive relationships across the EMEA partner ecosystem, positioning 7AI as a strategic priority within partners' GTM plans and establishing competitive lockout against emerging AI SOC entrants in the region.

  • Internal & External Evangelism: Act as the strategic advocate for EMEA partners inside 7AI, injecting "partner-first" DNA into our sales culture, while serving as the primary champion of 7AI's value within the regional partner ecosystem, at industry events, and with the regional press and analyst community.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Proven Revenue Leadership: 12+ years of high-tech business development or alliances experience within a high-growth cybersecurity or SaaS environment, including senior leadership of an EMEA or multi-country alliance organization, with a documented history of hitting or exceeding multi-million dollar partner-sourced targets.

  • Deep EMEA Network: Established, high-yield GTM partner and executive relationships already in place across the UK, Continental Europe, and the Middle East—spanning resellers, distributors, managed SOC/MDR providers, and global SIs—that can be leveraged on day one.

  • Greenfield Builder: Demonstrated success launching or scaling a partner-led business in a new region, including partner recruitment, contracting, enablement, and the operating cadence required to run a channel across multiple countries, languages, and business cultures.

  • Scale-First Leadership: Demonstrated ability to build structured partnership frameworks and lead a function that shifts business from traditional 1-to-1 sales toward a highly scalable, 1-to-many ecosystem model.

  • Alliances Strategy Mastery: Strong command of security operations, MDR/MSSP, SI, distribution, and cloud partner business models, with the strategic and tactical know-how to align their financial incentives with 7AI's growth.

  • High Execution Velocity: A self-starting leader with a "strong motor" who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, drives results with minimal oversight, and is comfortable operating remotely from headquarters with a distributed team.

  • Strategic & Operational Acumen: Excellent analytical and strategic skills to formulate a regional partnership vision, backed by the operational discipline and leadership to execute it at scale. Experience with European data residency, procurement, and regulatory considerations as they affect partner-delivered security services is a plus.

  • Location & Travel: Based in the UK or a major European hub, with the ability to travel extensively across the region and periodically to the United States.

  • Core Values: Impeccable honesty, high integrity, sound business judgment, and a BA/BS degree (advanced degree a plus). Fluency in English required; additional European languages a plus.
